description: Output schema for critical care blood gas assessment results. Each patient produces one object with these fields.

pH_status.description: Classification based on pH value relative to normal range

primary_disorder.description: Identified primary acid-base disorder based on pH status, PaCO2, and HCO3

corrected_anion_gap.description: Anion gap corrected for albumin level

anion_gap_classification.description: Based on the corrected anion gap

delta_ratio.description: Ratio of change in AG to change in bicarbonate from reference values. Null when not applicable.

delta_ratio_interpretation.description: Classification of the delta ratio. Refer to reference documentation for thresholds and edge cases.

expected_paco2.description: Expected PaCO2 for metabolic primary disorders. Null for respiratory or normal primaries.

expected_hco3.description: Expected HCO3 for respiratory primary disorders. Null for metabolic or normal primaries.

compensation_status.description: Whether the compensatory response is appropriate or indicates an additional disorder. Null when primary is normal.

corrected_potassium.description: Potassium corrected for pH deviation from normal

calculated_osmolarity.description: Calculated serum osmolarity. Must account for ethanol when present.

osmolar_gap.description: Difference between measured osmolality and calculated osmolarity

osmolar_gap_elevated.description: Whether the osmolar gap exceeds the clinical threshold

sid_apparent.description: Apparent strong ion difference. Note: divalent cations contribute 2 mEq per mmol.

sid_effective.description: Effective strong ion difference. See Stewart reference documentation.

strong_ion_gap.description: Difference between apparent and effective SID

o2er_status.description: Clinical classification of oxygen extraction ratio

pco2_gap_status.description: Classification based on clinical threshold. Refer to reference documentation.

notes.rounding: All numeric values rounded to 2 decimal places. Use unrounded intermediates for classification logic.
notes.nulls: Fields not applicable to the patient's clinical scenario must be null.
notes.units: Ensure correct unit handling, especially for divalent cation valence conversion in SID calculations.
